coverage.stage4: original character-dependent routing; no alternate Stage 4 override
coverage.last_words: not a selectable story route; not part of this 108-run matrix

initial_checkpoint.standard: Stage 1, non-practice, both final choices unlocked through one explicit prior Final B clear; clearState 2 is recorded
initial_checkpoint.extra: Extra stage, difficulty 4, non-practice original Extra initialization

continuation.eligibility: original outcome budget, a nonempty emitted prefix and frames below the unchanged total frame cap
continuation.rule: reconstruct every exact parent action from the same checkpoint; no earlier input changes; prefix work and original failed attempt stay charged

portfolio_order: try c16 and its eligible continuation; if still not verified complete, try c32 and its eligible continuation independently from the original checkpoint; retain all results
acceptance: solver process exit 0 and complete outcome
fresh full action replay from identical checkpoint, terminal, score, RNG and exact calculation/control events
natural .rpy replay with exact calculation rows, final score, zero death rows and zero bomb-input rows
observed complete ordered stage list equals each manifest expected_stages
full actions and .rpy byte hashes archived; failed emitted prefixes separately labeled and archived

random_seed_phase.start_after: all 108 baseline combinations have finalized bounded attempts and their validation/failures have been recorded
random_seed_phase.draw: fresh OS-entropy uint16 draws for a new complete matrix, frozen before any outcomes; seed identity belongs to every case
random_seed_phase.tuning: freeze any algorithm changes before random evaluation; an inspected seed is not a future holdout

resources.stop_rule: stop only campaign-owned work if host headroom becomes unsafe; retain partial outputs and costs

resource_revisions.reason: The first launch hit the shared user's hard RLIMIT_NPROC of 4096 (fork failed), without an OOM. The owner requested much less process concurrency. The campaign-owned unit was stopped; its failures, interrupted cases and measured costs are retained.
resource_revisions.rerun: new isolated result groups; no overwriting initial failures

evidence_limits: same-source verification is not an independent physics oracle
the preexisting pinned replay gate is 106/108; do not relax or rewrite its reference
a finite seed sample cannot prove all uint16 seeds
a budget or exhausted result is not a proof of impossibility
one previously retail-tested file does not retail-validate this matrix
